text: In their San Diego house, Katie believes [an evil presence has haunted her since childhood|origin|harm done in childhood], so her boyfriend Micah [sets up his new video camera in their bedroom|images|pictures, screens and recordings] to record it while they sleep. A psychic warns them not to communicate with what he calls a demon, but Micah keeps provoking it and [brings home a Ouija board|trigger|breaking a rule] against Katie's wishes. Night after night the footage grows worse, from slamming doors to footprints in baby powder, until [Katie rises in a trance and stares at Micah for hours|threat|being taken over].
